scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c cyan,green "npm run dev --workspace frontend" "npm run dev --workspace backend"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace frontend && npm run build --workspace backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace frontend && npm run lint --workspace backend
scripts.docker:dev:reset: docker compose --env-file .env.dev -f docker-compose.dev.yml down && docker volume rm -f portal-dev_pgdata-dev portal-dev_uploads-dev && docker compose --env-file .env.dev -f docker-compose.dev.yml up -d --build --wait && docker compose --env-file .env.dev -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T backend npx prisma migrate deploy && docker compose --env-file .env.dev -f docker-compose.dev.yml exec -T backend npm run seed:dev
scripts.docker:prod:seed: docker compose --env-file .env.prod -f docker-compose.prod.yml run --rm --build migrate npm run seed:prod
